$comment: Cloudflare estate inventory. Read by scripts/autonomy/estate-drift.mjs (weekly, read-only). Every live Worker must either have a wrangler config in this repo (matched by name) or be listed under off_repo_workers with a disposition. Snapshot taken 2026-09-26 from the Cloudflare API: 66 Workers, 7 D1 databases, 20 KV namespaces, 10 R2 buckets. Counts here are a snapshot for humans; the drift job always reads the live list.

dispositions.archive: Source recovered into docs/archive/cf-workers/. Goal: move to workers/<name> with a wrangler config that matches the live name.
dispositions.retire: Superseded. Owner confirms nothing routes to it, then deletes it in the Cloudflare dashboard (deleting is an owner action).
dispositions.unrelated: Not an AuthiChain surface. Keep off AuthiChain docs; ignore in drift.
dispositions.unknown: Source not found anywhere. Owner decides: snapshot or retire.

qron-self-heal.note: See OFFREPO_WORKERS.md. Superseded in spirit by ops-pulse.

qron-daily-ops.note: See OFFREPO_WORKERS.md. Superseded in spirit by owner-digest. Named in SECURITY-REMEDIATION-CRITICAL.md.

qron-stripe-webhook.note: Named in SECURITY-REMEDIATION-CRITICAL.md (pending rotation). Retire after the Stripe keys it used are rolled.

authichain-unified.note: June 2026 script; the app now runs as authichain-app (wrangler.app.jsonc).

stripe-webhook-worker.note: Last modified 2026-06-18; stripe-webhook (workers/stripe-webhook) is the live handler.

qron-edge.note: Decision 2026-10-21 (reversible): superseded by qron-edge-fleet, which is source-controlled in apps/qron-platform (src/edge.ts, canonical verify adapter test in src/edge.test.ts, bundle in docs/archive/cf-workers/qron-edge-fleet.js). qron-edge itself has no source in the repo and was last modified 2026-06-22. Before deleting it the owner confirms in the Cloudflare dashboard (Settings > Domains & Routes, and Metrics) that nothing routes to it and it has served no traffic recently. config/cloudflare-estate.json still says import-after-route-consumer-audit; if the audit finds a live consumer, switch this back and import the source instead.

storepilot.note: Decision 2026-10-21 (reversible): retire the Worker, keep the data. The repo has no source for it, StorePilot is hidden in src/lib/plans.ts, pricing copy says it is not sold (docs/growth/PRICING_FREEZE_COPY.md), and the revenue brief records zero pay or subscribe hits on its inbox. Keep the applied Supabase billing tables (supabase/migrations/20260920143338_storepilot_billing_tables.sql; do not invent a second migration). If merchant billing UX is wanted later, rebuild it in-repo as a thin surface over the shared Stripe webhook (docs/architecture/THIN_COMMERCIAL_SURFACES.md). The owner confirms nothing routes to the Worker before deleting it.

esktop.note: Created 2026-09-13; name looks like a typo and the script has no readable code (assets only).

collective-cloud.note: Static site plus a USGS earthquake feed proxy. Not an AuthiChain surface.

grok-cloudflare-toolchain.note: Live Cloudflare Worker with no in-repo source (Issue #1817). Awaiting owner confirmation to archive or retire.

expected_not_live.$comment: Repo configs that are intentionally not deployed under their own name.
